pages.text: Everything in this mod begins with $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$(). It grows as $(item)Deepslate Cherenkov Quartz Ore$() deep underground, Y -64 to 0 in the deepslate layer, in long thin veins; the ore glows faintly blue, so look along cave walls. Mine it with an $(thing)iron pickaxe$() or better.

Also found: 2-8 at a time in the supply caches of $(l:world/ruins)Observatory Ruins$(/l) - crashed research domes on the Overworld surface, which also hold Neutronium, a Spectral Analyzer or a spare Codex.$(br2)Holding $(item)Cherenkov Quartz$() once teaches the research symbol $(thing)ħ$() (reduced Planck constant) - the derivation of $(thing)Quantum Foundations$() and $(thing)The Casimir Effect$() needs it. Collect a few dozen: the first machines use it by the nine.
